literal_source_claim_en: a point inside a triangle for which the sum of the distances to the three vertices is minimal
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For three source-selected points forming a nondegenerate Euclidean triangle, characterize the unique global minimizer of the sum of its three vertex distances, with the source-selected less-than-120-degree interior branch and greater-than-or-equal-to-120-degree vertex branch.
statement_blocker: The catalog does not fix nondegeneracy, ambient and comparison domains, the meaning of inside, existence versus uniqueness versus characterization, or the 120-degree case split. Adding an all-angles-less-than-120-degrees hypothesis or broadening inside would change the received claim.
